tasks.title: Persistent Cloud task-queue manager (pure load/validate/next-dispatchable, lease-aware)
tasks.notes: Pure functions: loadQueue(json)->validate; nextDispatchable(queue, heldLeases)->task|null honoring single-ownership (a task already claimed via the atomic lease is never re-dispatched). Reuses the READY-invariant above. No I/O beyond reading the queue JSON; declares nothing READY on its own. Standalone proof (node, Node 24), not suite-registered (no config/validation.json edit).

tasks.title: 60-minute production reporter (completed tasks, new PRs, active implementers, failures, bottlenecks)
tasks.notes: Pure function buildReport({periodStart, periodEnd, prs, queue, runFacts})-> structured persistent report object + a markdown render. Fail-closed on missing inputs (reports UNKNOWN, never fabricates a completed count). The scheduled executor feeds it real gh/git facts; the pure core is what the proof covers.

tasks.title: Cloud CI-equivalent validator harness (Node 24 run-validation + tests -> honest evidence)
tasks.notes: Runs the repo's own validation + test commands under Node >=24 inside a cloud session and shapes the results into an honest evidence JSON (per-step pass/fail + duration). It is the cloud equivalent of the Local validation step (D2) while GitHub Actions is down; it is EXPLICITLY NOT a governance verdict and NOT a replacement for the governed independent reviewer or the real required CI checks. Must never emit a PASS it did not observe. The proof covers the fail-closed result-shaping (missing/garbled step output -> FAIL/UNKNOWN, never PASS).

tasks.title: Cloud dispatcher + single-ownership orchestration (create_session per READY task, lease-coordinated)
tasks.notes: Performed by the cloud orchestrator (this session) via claude-code-remote create_session: one implementer per independent READY task, each on its own branch -> its own PR, single-ownership enforced by the atomic lease. Implementers do NOT merge, reseal, approve, or touch protected paths. An implementer that finishes a task + opens a PR does NOT wait; the dispatcher advances it to the next READY task (directive item 5).

tasks.title: Persistent scheduled executors: continuous-dispatch/recovery + 60-min reporting (survive session end)
tasks.notes: Implemented via claude-code-remote scheduled triggers (routines): a recovery/continuous-dispatch routine that re-arms production after this cloud session ends, and a 60-minute production reporter. Does NOT touch the supervisor-owned scheduler state (.ai/runtime/, protected); this is a separate, non-protected cloud-production layer.
